subject: Aurora Health — residency, private peering, and KMS separation (requested evidence)
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@aurorahealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@aurorahealth.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 17:14:00 +01:00
Subject: Data residency & private peering evidence request — Aurora Health

Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week — Aurora security and infrastructure teams had a few follow-ups. We need formal, signed confirmations and supporting artifacts so our procurement and legal teams can clear Redwood for production with EU-only hosting and private peering. Specifically: 

1) Confirmation that customer data for Aurora (production) will be hosted exclusively in the EU region (no cross-border egress) except for an optional APAC DR site that must be explicitly authorized and documented.
2) A technical runbook or design diagram showing VPC private peering (shared VPC vs customer-managed peering), IP ranges, and how we can restrict egress to our approved services.
3) KMS/HSM keyflow: can keys for Aurora be segregated (customer partitioned keys) and do audit logs show key access by tenant?
4) Any SOC2 or CAIQ evidence items that reference network segmentation, peering, and key management (we use SIG/CAIQ).

Can you send a single packet (PDF or Drive link) that we can attach to our compliance review? We have a kick-off with procurement on Tue, Feb 23, so sooner is better.

Best,
Maria Lopez\Security Lead, Aurora Health
Attachment: none

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Data residency & private peering evidence request — Aurora Health

Maria — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned on requirements and I looped in Karthik (infra) and Irene (compliance). Summary of what we can deliver today and next steps below. Attaching a compact evidence packet and runbook; highlights here: 

- EU-only Hosting: Redwood supports pinning a tenant to the EU region (Frankfurt/Amsterdam) for all production inference and storage. By default we will not replicate or route production inference requests outside the designated EU clusters. Optional APAC failover is available but only with a signed DR addendum. See attached "aurora-eu-deployment-commitment_letter.pdf" for formal confirmation language.

- Private Peering Model: we support both customer-managed VPC peering (preferred for strict control) and a managed private link where we peer into an Aurora VPC. The attached "redwood-private-peering-runbook-v1.3.pdf" includes: peering options, CIDR negotiation guidance, BGP vs static routes, recommended egress ACLs, and sample Terraform snippets for establishing the peering.

- KMS/HSM keyflow: we provide tenant-scoped KMS keys (customer-managed keys in your KMS or a customer-specific partition in our KMS if you prefer). Access to keys is logged at the operation level and the logs are available for audit. See the attached diagram "kms-partitioning-diagram.png" and the runbook appendix for audit-log retention and sample CloudTrail mapping.

- Evidence for SIG/CAIQ: in the packet we include the relevant CAIQ sections we map to (network segregation, key management, access logging) and pointers to SOC2 controls that cover change management and monitoring. The packet contains links to the full CAIQ mapping and a short one-page summary for procurement.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm whether Aurora wants customer-managed peering or Redwood-managed private link.
2) If you want APAC DR enabled, we need a signed DR addendum (I can send a draft).
3) Karthik/Infra — please confirm the exact subnet ranges Aurora prefers and whether they require BGP.

I attached the runbook + diagram + commitment letter (see attachments list). If the procurement call needs more detail, we can hop on a 30-min call Tue morning CET.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt\Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@aurorahealth.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 11:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Data residency & private peering evidence request — Aurora Health

Maria — quick infra notes and a small ask before we finalize attachments: 

- Peering option recommendation: customer-managed VPC peering gives Aurora full control over route tables and egress ACLs. If you select this we will provide the peer IP (a /28) and a short BGP config if you want dynamic routes.
- If you prefer Redwood-managed private link, traffic terminates in our customer-dedicated subnet; egress controls are enforced by our network ACLs and we can provide proof logs. 
- KMS: we can either bring-your-own-KMS (preferred for highest isolation) or create a tenant partition with CMKs visible only to Aurora. In both cases, all key usage events are exported to audit logs and retained per our SOC2 schedule.

Request: can Aurora share the intended customer CIDR block (or a /22 range) and confirm whether BGP is permitted? That will let us include concrete route examples in the packet.

I'll also attach a short runbook excerpt and a sample CloudTrail-> SIEM mapping if helpful.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer\Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-peering-examples.txt (included in packet)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@aurorahealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 16:02:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Data residency & private peering evidence request — Aurora Health

Hannah, Karthik — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. Aurora will proceed with customer-managed VPC peering and BGP is acceptable. Our preferred CIDR for the peering is 10.40.0.0/22 (we'll reserve .0/.1 for transit). We also confirm we do NOT want any automatic failover to APAC unless we sign the DR addendum.

Procurement has the packet and the commitment letter; they may ask for a small redline to the residency wording (we'll mark it in DocuSign). Could you route the DocuSign envelope to me and to our legal (audits@aurorahealth.com)?

Appreciate the fast turnaround — can we schedule a 30-min tech sync Thu 10:00 CET to walk the runbook and confirm BGP parameters?

Regards,
Maria
Attachment: none
